extra.reason: Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md: install, bd ready, claim/close, seeding a fresh clone, and that issues.jsonl is an export rather than the source of truth.
Full jitter on {:exponential, _}; function form unchanged. Tests assert the ceiling and the absence of lockstep.
:retry_max_delay added, default 5s, caps every backoff form including a caller function; exponential now integer-shift and clamped.
Added :deadline (connection-level and per-call on every function that takes :timeout). Decision recorded in the issue design notes.
:retry_on_status defaulting to [429,502,503,504], retry-after honoured and capped by :retry_max_delay, idempotence gate unchanged.
Every call site now sets :idempotent from what the operation does; method rule kept as the default.
Table plus worst-case expression in the TypeDB moduledoc.
All six children landed: jitter, :retry_max_delay, :deadline, :retry_on_status with retry-after, per-operation retry eligibility, and the latency table.
Operation and transaction spans added, documented, and tested; :route added to keep metric tags bounded.
:database, :transaction_type and :transaction_id on operation and request spans; :metadata request option added for what the path cannot carry.
:log_level added as a per-connection floor; all logging behind TypeDB.Log; docs list every line; metadata keys now guarded by a test rather than by credo.
Warning on exhaustion and on failed renewal; [:typedb, :retry, :exhausted] event with :attempts.
